title:
Specialized {@link Engine} that executes all actions in a persistent Python (py4j) process.
For now, any subtype of Py.Engine can only have one instance per node. All Python-implemented methods on a Py.Engine
must use the same {@link ImplLanguage.Runtime}. For now, only the {@link Py4jExecutor} can be used.

NOTE: for now, all code in an Engine.Py that uses global variables to maintain state must live in a single engine
type and cannot be inherited
name: Engine.Py
